messages:
alisha: quick idea dump: move from ad-hoc pins to a tiny 'model token' object that routers and clients can always parse. keep it single-line for headers.
ben: sounds good. what's inside the token? need it minimal and unambiguous.
carmen: +1. avoid arrays of candidates inside headers; that killed perf before. prefer a prioritized single pick plus optional fallback hints.
alisha: propose fields: model, tag, hash, stability (stable|canary|deprecated), affinity (gpu|cpu|edge), activation_ts, rollout_id. example JSON inline: `{"model":"search-prod","tag":"v2.1","hash":"sha256:ab12...","stability":"canary","affinity":"gpu","activation_ts":1734620000,"rollout_id":"r-2026-03-xx"}` pack as base64 into X-RW-MODEL-TOKEN.
ben: what about aliases? customers pin tags. we need deterministic resolution order server-side, and an epoch to prevent split-brain.
alisha: alias map concept: alias -> [hashes] + epoch_id + issued_at. routers prefer hash entries that are active at now >= activation_ts and within activation_window; if none, fall back to prior epoch.
carmen: migration: old clients only know model+version. plan: server shim that will accept X-Model:search and Version:v2 and emit token for internal routing. add header `X-RW-Model-Schema:1` for clients that can do the token.
ben: storage and CDN: per-tenant small KV (ttl-backed) for fast writes and deletes; CDN for global cached lookups with short TTL to reduce load. make sure rollout deletions are propagated (invalidate CDN key on alias flip).
alisha: ops constraints: cap token header to ~512 bytes. dedupe identical hashes in storage to save space. include minimal telemetry keys: origin, operator_id.
carmen: also add a compact TLV codec for encoding tokens into 6-8 byte tags for each field when header size matters. I can prototype.
infra-bot: schema-check: model-token-v1 lint OK. requires hash when stability=stable. :white_check_mark: 
ben: one more tradeoff: content-hash = immutability (good audit) but forces clients to re-pin on rebuilds. allow `hash=null` for `stability=canary` to support OOT updates.
alisha: agreed. action items: draft RFC with model-token v1 spec + TLV codec + shim behavior; implement router shim and token decoder; CDN invalidation for alias flips; telemetry fields doc.
carmen: I'll prototype TLV and a minimal encoder CLI this sprint.
ben: I'll write the alias-epoch resolution pseudocode and fallback ordering.
alisha: schedule 30m sync Fri 10am to review RFC and migration plan.
